question: Who is led to the true guru — all intuition-entered, or the desiring?
premises: desiring desiring-to-go becomes, then would be led to true guru
not all intuition-entered by power would be led to true guru
inference: Desire leads to guru; mere intuition-entry does not guarantee it.
plain_english: Desiring desiring-to-go becomes, then would be led to true guru — not all intuition-entered by power would be led to true guru.
